dedupe_keys.name: our world in data co2 and greenhouse gases

description: Our World in Data maintains this combined dataset of carbon dioxide, other greenhouse gases and related energy indicators. It joins sources including the Global Carbon Project, national climate contributions, energy statistics, population and economic data. Tables contain one row per location and year, with annual, cumulative, per-capita and consumption-based measures; a codebook identifies each indicator and source. Coverage is international, while start and end years differ by indicator. CSV, XLSX and JSON distributions are public and free. OWID-produced data and code use CC-BY-4.0; original third-party terms also apply. A limitation is that region definitions and revisions change across sources and releases, and national indicators do not locate individual infrastructure assets. The data can constrain emissions and energy assumptions in long-term infrastructure simulations. GCAM (model-gcam) is related integrated-assessment modelling software. Only the repository documentation was read; no data table was downloaded.
